additional_info.subject: RE: ID0369416-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R3 170001705] Left LED ribbon defective CRM:00921000987
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Please plan the site intervention & require to check the followings-
1. We need to ensure for the 24V
2. Need to Ensure 0v.
3. Validate the continuity from the SECC KF211 to the LED Dimmer KF215.
4. Need to ensure the DIP Switch is as per the below image.
If we have issue with 24v, We have to back test the connection.
We need to check FC212, And validate if it is working fine.
Further We need to validate if we are getting power at TB210.
If all the connections are fine, we may have to consider replacing the LED Dimmer. KF215
.
